e: Borrowed from Japanese オムライス (omuraisu), from French omelette and English rice.
q: Things like yakisoba and katsu curry are all examples of this western mixing, while omurice has both French and American influences. I’m 50 now and I remember growing up in the 1970s with my mother making me omurice.
